audioFeatures.bannerSub: Hardware and C++ powered acoustic filters bringing studio podcast clarity to your calls.
audioFeatures.fullBandDesc: Breaks through standard 8–14 kHz cellular limits, transmitting vocal warmth and breath clarity across full 48,000 Hz sampling. Prevents tinny or muffled audio.
audioFeatures.spatialDesc: When wearing headphones, rescues voice from a flat centered mono point in your head. Imparts subtle binaural depth making the speaker feel 1 meter in front of you, preventing fatigue.
audioFeatures.latencyDesc: Bypasses server queues and relays directly via P2P Fast RAM channels. Enables natural conversational rhythm without stepping on each other's words.
audioFeatures.eqDesc: Applies a studio mastering curve (+2.0dB chest warmth and +2.5dB vocal articulation). Completely eliminates harsh digital clipping or distortion when shouting or speaking close to mic.
audioFeatures.comfortDesc: Maintains a subtle, warm ambient comfort floor during silence to eliminate dead-air anxiety while preventing abrupt, artificial syllable cutoff.

tunnel.title: Network Settings
tunnel.liveP2pDesc: P2P Direct & Cloudflare Anycast TURN active. Initiates STUN NAT hole-punching directly between peer hardware enclaves with automatic Anycast TURN relay fallback across symmetric cellular networks.
tunnel.liveCloudDesc: Cloud TLS Proxy initialized. Forcing call traffic through Port 443 TCP/UDP. Packets are actively masked as standard TLS 1.3 HTTPS traffic with Agora SD-RTN hardware noise reduction.
tunnel.liveStealthDesc: Stealth HTTP/3 active. Cross-platform native QUIC is engaged, DoQ/DoH resolves with direct IP Pinning, serverless Vercel Edge relay is standing by, edge chaff filtering is armed, and exact 2-pass multi-bucket CBR shaping is camouflaging media frames as benign web telemetry.
tunnel.p2pBullet1Desc: Resolves public network addresses using decentralized STUN handshakes.
tunnel.p2pBullet2Desc: Uniquely pairs peer endpoints with no middle-man servers ever handling media packets.
tunnel.p2pBullet3Desc: Enforces forward secrecy with temporary keys negotiated purely on-device.
tunnel.cloudBullet1Desc: Leverages distributed global points of presence for ultra low latency connectivity.
tunnel.cloudBullet2Desc: Blends calling packets into benign web browser streams.
tunnel.cloudBullet3Desc: Resolves symmetric firewalls instantly, conserving battery and processor cycles.
tunnel.stealthBullet1Desc: Dispatches call sessions over Chromium Cronet (Android) and native URLSession HTTP/3 (iOS) with 0-RTT UDP 443 connection migration.
tunnel.stealthBullet2Desc: Resolves hostnames via encrypted QUIC (port 853) and HTTPS Anycast resolvers with zero local disk footprints.
tunnel.stealthBullet3Desc: Directly binds resolved IP addresses into native socket transport while maintaining standard TLS SNI Host headers.
tunnel.stealthBullet4Desc: Covert HTTP/3 signaling proxy deployed on Vercel Edge with Upstash KV and in-memory fast-path caching.
tunnel.stealthBullet5Desc: Emits synthetic noise bursts acknowledged with 200 OK at the edge and pruned before peer dispatch to conserve device bandwidth.
tunnel.stealthBullet6Desc: Enforces deterministic byte-perfect padding across 512B, 1024B, 1536B, and 2048B envelopes to defeat packet-length DPI heuristics.
tunnel.techSpecTransportDesc: Signaled sessions are encapsulated in military-grade DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) with perfect forward secrecy. Zero central record keeping is performed, and only ephemeral peer-exchanged keys can decrypt the active audio stream.
tunnel.techSpecCollateralDesc: Cloud TLS & Stealth modes utilize standard TLS-packet markers to simulate benign web traffic. This forces censoring firewalls to choose between allowing the call session or dropping millions of commercial web accesses across their networks.
tunnel.techSpecNatDesc: Under extreme symmetric NAT (such as complex cellular configurations), standard hole-punching falls back gracefully, preserving key integrity, metadata invisibility, and uncompromised audio confidentiality.
tunnel.p2pFeat1Desc: Negotiates peer connections directly using STUN without intermediate relays.
tunnel.p2pFeat2Desc: Seamless fallback to Anycast TURN across symmetric cellular NATs.
tunnel.p2pFeat3Desc: Saves battery and optimizes voice quality by avoiding unnecessary routing.
tunnel.cloudFeat1Desc: Encapsulates call control signaling within standard SSL secure web traffic.
tunnel.cloudFeat2Desc: Masquerades session initiations to bypass network-level protocol filters.
tunnel.cloudFeat3Desc: Maintains voice communication with hardware AI noise cancellation.
tunnel.stealthFeat1Desc: Transmits call signaling over native Chromium Cronet (Android) and URLSession HTTP/3 (iOS 15+) engines with 0-RTT connection migration.
tunnel.stealthFeat2Desc: Queries DNS over QUIC (port 853) with DoH fallback to AdGuard/Cloudflare/Quad9, completely evading local ISP DNS spoofing.
tunnel.stealthFeat3Desc: Pins resolved IP directly to underlying QUIC/socket transport while preserving RFC-compliant Host headers to defeat DNS interception.
tunnel.stealthFeat4Desc: Sub-100ms covert signaling proxy over Vercel Edge with Upstash KV & memory fast-path caching.
tunnel.stealthFeat5Desc: Sends high-entropy Poisson noise packets acknowledged with 200 OK at edge and pruned before peer delivery, eliminating silence footprints.
tunnel.stealthFeat6Desc: Calibrates envelope sizes byte-perfect to 512B, 1024B, 1536B, or 2048B buckets to defeat advanced DPI statistical and length profiling.
tunnel.bottomNote: inWhite routes entirely serverless and decentralized across peer-to-peer tunnels. No records or social maps are held outside of your hardware secure enclave.

info.title: Information
info.guideSubtitle: This guide details the operation, security protocols, and feature sets of the inWhite platform. Follow these step-by-step instructions to configure your secure communications node.
info.guideStep1Text: inWhite does not use central databases, phone numbers, emails, or personal telemetry.
info.guideStep1WhiteIdDesc: Upon launching the app, a cryptographically secure public/private key pair (Curve25519) is generated inside your device's hardware enclave. Your identity is represented solely as a unique decentralized identifier (whiteID e.g. 03a1b2c3...).
info.guideStep1LockDesc: Tapping "Register" permanently locks these credentials onto your local device storage using standard hardware-backed Keystore or Keychain systems. There is no remote password retrieval path; your ID belongs strictly to your hardware.
info.guideStep2Text: Add physical peers face-to-face or via trusted secure channels without disclosing metadata.
info.guideStep2ExchangeDesc: Go to the Contacts view, tap the scan icon on the top right or the Add Person screen, and use your device camera to scan your partner's dynamic QR code. This instantly exchanges public cryptographic key fingerprints over-the-air.
info.guideStep2DirectoryDesc: Your address book exists exclusively in an AES-256-GCM encrypted database stored locally. The app never queries central contacts directories.
info.guideStep2StealthDesc: For maximum discretion, enable "Hide contacts from main view" under Call Settings. Contacts will match and show up instantly only when searched.
info.guideStep3Text: All call media streams over decentralized tunnels utilizing low-latency engines.
info.guideStep3PerfDesc: Powered by pre-compiled C++ WebRTC and Agora frameworks, inWhite delivers full-band 48kHz CD-quality voice signals.
info.guideStep3DspDesc: Implements native AEC (Acoustic Echo Cancellation), AI ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) to eliminate traffic/wind noise, and AGC (Automatic Gain Control) to dynamically balance capture levels.
info.guideStep3FallbackDesc: Call connections monitor packet drop rates dynamically. If cellular/ISP interference is detected, the audio gateway activates direct millisecond port-shuffling and traffic-shaping relays.
info.guideStep4Text: Send ephemeral texts, files, and cryptographic hashes securely.
info.guideStep4E2eeDesc: Message content is sealed client-side before transport and can only be decrypted by the recipient's private key.
info.guideStep4RatchetDesc: For extreme confidentiality, communication tunnels dynamically scramble message header metadata on every single transaction, leaving zero trail for corporate or government interceptors.
info.guideStep5Text: Asynchronous, zero-metadata communications powered by device-to-device public key cryptography, entirely free of centralized SMTP/IMAP servers:
info.guideStep5E2eeDesc: Both the subject, message body, and binary attachments are encrypted client-side using recipient's public key (bod_whiteID).
info.guideStep5FoldersDesc: Manage your communications across Inbox, Outbox, Sent, Deleted, and Archive with instantaneous local indexing and full-text offline search.
info.guideStep5PairingDesc: Unknown senders must submit a cryptographic peer request before delivering unsolicited messages, eliminating spam at the protocol level.
info.guideStep6Text: Direct engineering support and ticket management with absolute anonymity and zero KYC requirements:
info.guideStep6AnonymousDesc: Support tickets are anchored strictly to your hardware whiteID. No email address, telephone number, or real name is ever required or logged.
info.guideStep6LifecycleDesc: Track support progress through Open, Answered, and Closed statuses, and continue interactive encrypted conversations with support specialists.
info.guideStep6MediaDesc: Attach screenshots, camera captures, and diagnostic logs securely encrypted on-device to accelerate issue resolution.
info.guideStep7Text: Fine-tune multi-tier network traversal and dynamic fallback thresholds in the Tunnel Settings screen:
info.guideStep7P2pDesc: Direct peer-to-peer media streaming via STUN/ICE hole-punching with Cloudflare TURN relay fallback. Zero unnecessary relays, lowest latency.
info.guideStep7CloudDesc: High-resilience routing over standard HTTPS Port 443 with TLS 1.3 encapsulation, perfectly mimicking generic secure web browsing.
info.guideStep7StealthDesc: Multi-edge covert HTTP/3 steganography with milisecond port-shuffling and packet obfuscation to bypass active Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) blocks.
info.guideStep7AdaptiveDesc: Real-time latency diagnostics dynamically calibrate failover timeouts (3.5s – 12.0s) or allow manual control, ensuring unbroken calls even under volatile networks.
info.manifestoMissionDesc: inWhite was designed with a single, unyielding commitment: to restore digital autonomy through absolute privacy. In a digital landscape dominated by centralized data harvesting, inWhite serves as a decentralized bastion for unmonitored, secure, and truly private interpersonal communication.
info.manifestoPhilosophyP1Desc: Zero personal information footprint. No phone numbers, no email addresses, no real-world social identities required.
info.manifestoPhilosophyP2Desc: Users exist as completely autonomous entities identified solely by a self-generated, locally-stored whiteID. No central authority holds the map of who communicates with whom.
info.manifestoPhilosophyP3Desc: All traffic is dynamically masked via TLS 443 tunneling and Agora Cloud Proxy, ensuring communication remains uninterrupted and untraceable even in heavily restricted network environments.
info.manifestoSecurityP1Desc: Interaction starts with a device-generated asymmetric key pair. Your identity is a mathematical certainty, not a digital dossier.
info.manifestoSecurityP2Desc: All voice and messaging data is encrypted using cryptographic keys unique to the communicating devices. Third-party infrastructure providers see nothing but meaningless noise.
info.manifestoSecurityP3Desc: Your social network, contact list, and message history are never stored in a central cloud. They reside only on your device, protected by localized encryption layers.
info.manifestoDataDesc1: Your communication history is persisted locally and securely on your device, encrypted at rest. We do not store your messages, media, or contact lists on any central servers.
info.manifestoDataDesc2: While your conversations remain accessible on your device for your personal convenience, they exist exclusively under your control. You may clear your local application state at any time, which permanently and irreversibly removes all data from your device, with no remote backup or recovery path.
info.privacySubtitle: Your private communication is a fundamental human right. Our zero-telemetry technical architecture guarantees your metadata and signal paths remain strictly isolated from third-party observation.
info.qa1Answer: No. inWhite adheres to a strict Zero Personal Data policy. No phone numbers, emails, names, contacts directories, or GPS coordinates are requested, captured, or stored.
info.qa2Answer: Your identity is completely autonomous and mathematical. A unique public/private key pair is generated locally on your hardware. Your whiteID is an offline hashing representation of this key pair.
info.qa3Answer: All data, including secure contact books, messaging logs, calling cache, and configuration keys are stored locally on your device within encrypted databases secured by hardware keys (Keystore/Keychain).
info.qa4Answer: Conversations are completely ephemeral and local, ensuring no centralized message logs exist. All communications are protected by end-to-end encryption (E2EE) and local storage.
info.qa5Answer: We commit that no developer, vendor, or third-party proxy can access, store, reconstruct, or disclose user communications. All signaling payloads, cryptographic fingerprints, and network packets are treated as strictly confidential and untrackable. This is our binding privacy pact with you.
info.qa6Question: Does inWhite Mail use traditional SMTP/IMAP servers?
info.qa6Answer: No. inWhite Mail completely bypasses legacy email infrastructure. Messages and attachments are delivered directly between sovereign WhiteIDs using cryptographic asymmetric encryption. No external mail servers, DNS records, or metadata headers exist.
info.qa7Question: How does the Help Desk protect my identity?
info.qa7Answer: Support tickets are cryptographically anchored solely to your local hardware WhiteID. You are never prompted for an email address, phone number, name, or payment details to receive full technical support.
